info.title: GATEWAY-apiwizruntimedoc-Delete Payments Payments Void-v1-spec
info.description: The Payments Void API enables merchants to reverse or void transactions that have not yet been settled. This operation is essential for managing payment errors or cancellations, allowing for efficient transaction handling and minimizing potential losses. Typical consumers include merchants and payment processors who need to ensure accurate financial records. By using this API, users can maintain compliance and enhance customer service by promptly addressing transaction adjustments.

delete.description: This API endpoint allows you to void a previously completed payment transaction. It is useful in scenarios where a payment needs to be canceled and any associated funds need to be returned to the customer's account.

requestBody.description: Request body for voiding a payment. This should include the necessary details to identify the payment to be voided.

200.description: The void request was processed successfully.

DeletePaymentsPaymentsVoidRequest.description: This schema represents the request body for a void operation in the payments operations, specifically for DELETE requests. It is expected to be a JSON string.

status.description: Indicates whether the void operation was successful.

referenceNumber.description: The reference number associated with the void operation.

resultId.description: The unique identifier for the result of the void operation.

state.description: The current state of the void operation.

processingTimeMs.description: The time taken to process the void operation, in milliseconds.

message.description: Additional message providing more context about the void operation.

DeletePaymentsPaymentsVoidResponse_200.description: Response schema for the successful void operation.

createdBy.description: The identifier of the user or system that created the record.

createdAt.description: The timestamp of when the record was created.

automated.description: Indicates whether the operation was performed automatically.

AuditDetails.description: Details about the audit trail for the operation.

x-processing-time.description: Indicates the time taken to process the request in milliseconds.
